bear_case.summary: EME is not a deep value name (P/E 24) - it screens 'cheap' only relative to industrial-services peers. The bear case is concentration in data-center / network & communications construction: record RPOs ($17.1B, +44%) imply peak-cycle margins (10.6% op margin) that historically mean-revert. Any hyperscaler capex pause or fixed-price project cost overrun hits a richly valued stock.
risks: Labor scarcity/wage inflation for skilled trades
